emptyLink: No extension yet? Download it and see how to install.
dialogIntro: The extension records a tab in Chrome; this Player replays the exported archive. Everything you need is on this page.
downloadMissing: This Player build does not bundle the extension.
downloadMissingHow: Ask whoever serves this Player for a build that includes it, or build it yourself: run pnpm --filter @webblackbox/extension package:chrome before pnpm build.
copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it yourself.
installStepLoad: Click “Load unpacked” and choose the unzipped folder.
installStepPin: Pin WebBlackbox: the puzzle-piece icon in the Chrome toolbar, then the pin next to WebBlackbox.
updateBody: Download and unzip the new version, replace the folder's contents with it, then press the reload icon on the WebBlackbox card at chrome://extensions.
updateWarning: Reloading the extension discards the recordings that were never exported — export them first.
connectBody: Paste this Player's address into the extension's Options, the “Player URL” field. “Export and open in Player” on the Sessions page then opens this Player after every export; only the page opens — the archive stays on this computer.
connectPolicy: Administrators can set the same address for everyone with the managed policy key playerUrl.
recordStepProfile: Open the extension popup. It records with the “Maximum” profile — everything, recorded raw, with screenshots and tab video; the archive is always encrypted. “Light” records page-side only. Change the profile in the extension's Options (“Profiles”); site rules can still pick a profile for a site.
recordStepStart: Click “Record”. It asks “Reload the Page When Recording Starts?”: “Reload and Record” captures the page load from scratch (the first requests and scripts); “Record Without Reload” keeps the page as is. Tick “Don't ask again” to keep your answer (Options: “Page reload on Start”). While Maximum records, Chrome shows a “started debugging this browser” bar: leave it open — “Cancel” there switches the recording to Light (the toolbar badge shows LITE).
recordStepStop: Click “Stop” when you are done. The popup switches to the export step: click “Export archive” right away. “Later” keeps the recording on the Sessions page until you export or delete it (until the browser closes); the toolbar badge shows SAVE meanwhile.
recordStepPassphrase: The first export asks for a passphrase of at least 8 characters. Archives are always encrypted (AES-GCM), and you need the passphrase to open the archive. It is remembered until the browser closes, so later exports do not ask; “Forget passphrase” drops it.
recordStepOpen: Open the exported .webblackbox file here: choose it with the file picker or drop it anywhere on this page — or use “Export and open in Player” on the extension's Sessions page. Enter the same passphrase when the Player asks.
troubleCrypto: The Player verifies and decrypts archives with the Web Crypto API, which browsers expose only on HTTPS pages and on http://localhost / 127.0.0.1. On plain HTTP no archive opens (“Web Crypto API or Node crypto is required for SHA-256 hashing.”). Serve the Player over HTTPS.
troubleIncomplete: If a recording looks incomplete, open “About this recording” (the session block in the header, or the ⋯ menu) and check “What this archive contains”: every data kind is marked “complete”, “partial” or “not recorded”.
troubleErrors: Errors show in the popup (for example “Start failed: …”) and as an “ERR” badge on the toolbar icon. “LITE” means Full capture stopped and the recording goes on in Light; the popup says why, and the archive records it. Technical details are in the service worker console (chrome://extensions → WebBlackbox → “service worker”).
